name: FxWallet
description: FxWallet is a self-custody multi-chain wallet for iPhone and Android, supporting 70+ blockchains including Alephium. It holds ALPH, Alephium tokens and NFTs, and ALPH transfers can be signed on a Goldshell hardware wallet by QR code or on a second phone kept offline.
short_description: A self-custody multi-chain mobile wallet that supports Alephium.
